items.question: How safe is Singapore?
items.answer: We felt exceptionally safe. The orderliness is not merely visual; public spaces remained comfortable late into the evening.

items.question: Is English commonly understood?
items.answer: Yes. English is widely used and navigating as an English-speaking traveller is unusually easy for Asia.

items.question: What could ruin my stay in Singapore?
items.answer:
Expecting Southeast Asian chaos and then deciding Singapore lacks “authenticity” because it is clean and regulated. The planning is part of the culture and part of what makes the place interesting.

Also, do not schedule every hour. The city is at its best when you have enough spare time to notice how it works.
